cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Co-sign for borrowing this barbecue. You used to need me beside you for every inspection; now you can be a joint custodian.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good eye. You finally check before lifting. Write the crack beside both our names and sign; we'll inspect the rest together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me choose one as joint custodian. I'll call the shops; you approve the replacement. Let's see you use that careful eye before we both owe her a barbecue.
